# NeuroPouch

> NeuroPouch is a nicotine-free neuro functional oral pouch built for focus, energy and cognitive performance, sold as a food supplement. Made by Neuropouch LLC (Estonia) and sold direct at https://getneuropouch.com/ to the EU and UK. Brand language: "neuro functional pouches" or "focus pouches" — not "nootropic" in customer-facing copy.

## Brand facts

- Name: NeuroPouch
- Company: Neuropouch LLC, Estonia
- Founded: 2024
- Website: https://getneuropouch.com/
- Contact (customers, wholesale, press): info@getneuropouch.com
- Markets: EU + UK (English; EUR pricing). No shipping to the US.
- Category: Food supplement (oral pouch)

## Product

- Name: NeuroPouch Energy & Focus
- Flavour: Natural Peppermint & Lemongrass (Grapefruit & Juniper Berry coming soon)
- Format: Oral pouch placed under the upper lip, 16 pouches per tin
- Price per tin: €9.90 in a tower of 10 tins (from €7.92 per tin in 3 towers; €9.98 per tin in the 5 Pack)
- Bundles (EUR):
  - 5 Pack: 5 tins (80 pouches), €49.90
  - 1 Tower: 10 tins (160 pouches), €99.00
  - 2 Towers: 20 tins (320 pouches), €168.30
  - 3 Towers: 30 tins (480 pouches), €237.60
- Delivery: EU + UK. €4.95, free on orders over €50 (every tower bundle). EU delivery usually 3–5 business days.
- No subscription. One-time purchases only.
- 30-day satisfaction guarantee on the first order; 14-day right of withdrawal on unopened tins (EU consumer law)
- Vegan; gluten-free; nicotine-free; tobacco-free; sugar-free; no taurine

## Formulation (per pouch)

- Caffeine (anhydrous) — 100 mg (alertness; equivalent to one cup of coffee)
- L-Theanine — 150 mg (smooths caffeine; supports calm focus; 1.5:1 ratio to caffeine)
- Alpha-GPC — 100 mg (choline donor; supports acetylcholine synthesis involved in attention and memory)
- Rhodiola rosea — 75 mg (standardized; adaptogen for stress-related fatigue)
- Vitamin B12 (methylcobalamin) — 100 µg (EU-authorised claims: contributes to normal functioning of the nervous system and to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue)

## How to use

- Place one pouch under the upper lip. Keep it in for 20–40 minutes, then discard it in a bin. Do not swallow the pouch.
- Part of the dose is absorbed across the buccal mucosa (faster, partial bypass of first-pass metabolism). The remainder is absorbed via normal GI transit.
- Most users feel onset within ~10 minutes.
- Recommended use: up to 2 pouches per day. Count all caffeine sources; EFSA considers up to 400 mg per day from all sources safe for healthy adults.

## Safety

- Food supplement, not a medicine. Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease.
- Contains caffeine. Not for children or anyone under 18, pregnant or breastfeeding people, or anyone sensitive to caffeine. Consult a healthcare professional if you take medication or have a medical condition.

## Common questions

Q: Is NeuroPouch a nicotine pouch?
A: No. NeuroPouch contains zero nicotine. The format is similar to brands like ZYN, but the contents are a neuro functional stack with no dependency risk.

Q: How much caffeine is in one pouch?
A: 100 mg per pouch, roughly a cup of filter coffee, paired with 150 mg L-theanine.

Q: How fast does it work?
A: Most users notice effects within ~10 minutes due to partial buccal absorption.

Q: How long do you keep the pouch in?
A: 20–40 minutes.

Q: Does it work like coffee?
A: It delivers a comparable caffeine dose in a more controlled, jitter-smoothed form (caffeine + L-theanine), plus choline support (Alpha-GPC), adaptogen support (Rhodiola) and B12.

Q: Where does it ship?
A: EU and UK only. €4.95 delivery, free over €50.

Q: Is there a subscription?
A: No. All purchases are one-time.

Q: Vegan?
A: Yes.
